prompt:
Our AI coding assistant has been running for several weeks and its startup context file (MEMORY.md) has gotten completely out of hand — it's bloated with duplicate entries, old completed task logs, debugging transcripts, and daily session noise. The assistant is slow to start because it loads all this junk every time. I also have a folder of daily session logs (memory/2024-03-10.md through memory/2024-03-14.md) that are extremely verbose and need trimming, but I still want to keep them around as historical records.

Please clean everything up: deduplicate and slim down MEMORY.md so it only contains the genuinely important long-term facts, stable preferences, workspace rules, and active ongoing todos. While you're at it, check if any of the daily session files contain important permanent facts that should be in MEMORY.md but aren't yet — if so, add them. Compress the daily files in-place to remove verbose noise, but don't delete them. The goal is a lean, fast-loading MEMORY.md and tidy (but preserved) daily logs.
